candidate: A compartment experiment-and-design instrument that transfers from source-detection sensor design to protective mitigation design
purpose: Construct accepted observation and control means for a supplied nonnegative linear transport/reaction class. The scientific question is whether retained measured dynamics support a fresh intervention design, and whether any advantage survives ordinary reuse.
source_limit: Mass conservation, reaction and system-identification principles inform the model. The finite compartment systems are independently authored synthetic fixtures, not EPANET pipe-network data, measured apparatus, unknown-law discoveries, or validated field transport.
class: Time-invariant x_next = A x, A nonnegative and every column sum at most one. The deficit is explicitly tracked decay/exported mass. Numerical observation tolerance 1e-8. Dimension2–8 is a finite experimental search bound, not a business ceiling.
observation_contract: Constructor receives dimension and callable one-step oracle only, not hidden A or future task outcomes. It may query nonnegative mass vectors. Zero, coordinate unit injections, and two fixed convex mixture probes cost one observation each.
k1: Identify a scoped transition instrument from observations, then exhaustively construct the cheapest sensor subset separating possible unit-release locations over a supplied horizon. Sensor installation costs and required separation are supplied units.
k1_freeze: Freeze all identified transition bytes, query receipts, source nodes, sensor plan, model assumptions and checker verdict before generating fresh K2 protected targets and intervention request.
k2: For new protected nodes, horizon and release-source uncertainty, construct a static treatment plan robust to every possible listed release source. Treatments remove0,0.5 or1 of current mass at eligible nodes before each transition. Removal is accounted as disposed mass, never free disappearance.
treatment_costs: Positive declared installation, operation and disposal resource units. Search all catalogue plans and retain the least cost with deterministic tie rules. These units are not supplier quotations or company expenses.
controls: No-mechanism: passive zero signal cannot identify arbitrary A and must refuse a point-identified guarantee
Strong conventional: direct coordinate-experiment identification and exhaustive sensor/mitigation search with identical oracle access
No-inheritance: reacquire all observations and construct K2 afresh
Equal-content ordinary reuse: receive the exact identified instrument and construct K2 without a claimed discovery procedure
Revised task without revised scope: preserve and demonstrate a failing old task-specific guarantee where a different protected target requires redesign

acceptance.mitigation: every possible source must meet its supplied exposure limit within1e-8
acceptance.optimality: independent enumeration confirms minimum cost in finite catalogue
acceptance.independence: separate agent chooses fixtures and checks outcomes; shared-host procedural separation is not OS secrecy or external certification

confirmation: Verifier chooses32 fresh valid systems of dimension3–6 after constructor freeze, plus explicit negative controls. Each has one K1 sensor task and one fresh K2 mitigation task. Source, task and result denominators are all retained. No parameter revision from confirmation outcomes.
negative_controls: new protected target may invalidate old treatment plan
failure_policy: A rejected identification cannot pass a synthetic downstream invention claim. Infeasible sensor/control requests are valid bounded results and must not be erased. A conventional or equal-content tie disallows discovery superiority.
costs: Record every experimental query, finite candidate count, numerical CPU/wall time and cold-versus-retained acquisition cost. Physical preparation, sensors, treatment yield, fabrication, specialist qualification, adoption, financing, liability and maintenance remain unmeasured deployment assumptions.
commercial_boundary: The offered hypothetical deliverable is a checked computational instrument/design contract, never installed treatment capacity, a public-health decision or measured pollutant removal. No real customer, rights monopoly or revenue is established.
